title: Expose pair and material capability queries
scope: Add registry-generated per-pair/per-mode/material capability discovery and negative tests.
acceptance: An external SDK consumer enumerates exact modes and limits.
Unknown pairs/modes and unsupported material combinations return documented results.
evidence: PASS: python3 tools/check_sdk_install.py --build-dir build-foundations --output /tmp/pm-f2-sdk-final-20261017; a separately built vendor driver and installed C/C++ SDK consumers enumerate an exact finite limit and verify malformed pair/mode plus unsupported mode/material results.

PASS: cmake --build build-foundations -j2 and ctest --test-dir build-foundations -j2 --output-on-failure; all 46 configured tests passed, with only the three documented unsupported CPU domain/coupling/paint suites skipped.

PASS: python3 tools/reference/build.py --check-generated and cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -pedantic-errors -Iinclude -fsyntax-only examples/sdk/devices.c; generated headers/specification match the registry and the public C ABI is strict-C11 clean.

REVIEW: registry/pm.xml is the reference capability inventory; tools/registry/generate.py emits per-driver records filtered by exact feature requirements, including independent smoke representations and graph limits.
